title: Zero to Mastery ML offers notebooks for end-to-end machine-learning practice
friendlyTitle: Zero to Mastery ML provides practical machine-learning notebooks
summary: Zero to Mastery ML provides course notebooks, datasets and projects covering pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, structured data and deep learning. The repository has about 7,100 stars and can be opened through Binder or Google Colab.
friendlySummary: This open repository teaches data tools, machine learning and deep learning through notebooks and projects. It has about 7,100 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: New practitioners can follow a project-based path from data preparation through model building and communication without assembling a curriculum from scratch. Because some material reflects established rather than newest tooling, pair it with current library documentation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it for a clear learning path and hands-on practice. Check the latest library documents when commands or tools have changed.
